de_rdb_71231_02_hebesaetze_2025.publisher: Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder (Regionaldatenbank Deutschland)
de_rdb_71231_02_hebesaetze_2025.dataset: Tabelle 71231-02-01-5 Hebesätze der Realsteuern, Gemeinden, Stichtag 30.06.2025
de_rdb_71231_02_hebesaetze_2025.notes: Columns A,B,C,Gewerbesteuer; a '-' means no value reported. Grundsteuer B 2025 is post-reform; NRW municipalities with split residential/non-residential rates are missing or carry the residential rate (e.g. Köln 475). fr_insee_filosofi_2021.dataset: Filosofi 2021 – revenus disponibles par commune (via data.gouv.fr 'Revenu des français à la commune')
fr_insee_filosofi_2021.notes: Median disposable income per consumption unit ([DISP] Médiane) and share of social minima in disposable income; communes under statistical secrecy absent. Paris/Lyon/Marseille only exist by arrondissement in the source, so the commune codes 75056/69123/13055 get no income value (not aggregated).

fr_dgfip_fiscalite_locale_2025.dataset: Fiscalité locale des particuliers – exercice 2025 (taux_global_tfb, taux_plein_teom)
fr_dgfip_fiscalite_locale_2025.notes: Global TFPB rate = commune + EPCI + syndicates + special levies. The mirror dropped values above 100%. TEOM only where the commune levies it.

fr_dhup_carte_loyers_2025.publisher: Ministère chargé du Logement (DHUP) with ANIL / Cerema / INRAE model
fr_dhup_carte_loyers_2025.dataset: Carte des loyers – indicateurs de loyers d'annonce par commune en 2025 (pred-app, pred-app12, pred-app3, pred-mai)
fr_dhup_carte_loyers_2025.notes: loypredm2 = predicted advertised rent incl. charges, EUR/m2/month. Most communes are estimated on a grouped mesh (TYPPRED=maille: about 86% for apartments) rather than their own listings. PLM published by arrondissement only.

nl_cbs_kwb_2024.dataset: Kerncijfers wijken en buurten 2024 (85984NED), gemeente rows
nl_cbs_kwb_2024.notes: The mirror is a column subset: there is no WOZ value or personal income in this file. Income figures are values ×1000 EUR, converted to EUR.

nl_cbs_kwb_2025.dataset: Kerncijfers wijken en buurten 2025 (86165NED) – export for NL and big cities
